oncall-bot: ALERT: detected partial egress degradation in eu-west-1b impacting GPU serving pool "redwood-pool-gpu7". Packet loss ~1-3%, p95 token latency up ~160ms. Started 2024-06-10T11:53Z. Incident id evt-1749994321

jamie (infra): I see prefix/KV cache miss rate +28% and KV eviction spikes. Memory under pressure on several g4dn nodes. Dedicated customers affected for heavy-gen routes.

sylvie (eng-sre): Confirmed. netstat shows tx_queue drops and retransmits. Autoscaler couldn't add because regional GPU quota at ~90%. Avoid bulk relocate; do staged weight-shift + node cordon/drain.

arpit (eng-platform): Proposed runbook (short):
1) reduce traffic weight from the pool by ~30% to other AZs
2) cordon nodes in small batches (3) and drain with 2m grace
3) prewarm caches on target AZs before routing
Commands I'm running now:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-123
kubectl drain gpu-node-123 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
curl -X POST https://router.internal/api/weights -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN" -d '{"pool":"redwood-pool-gpu7","weight_delta":-0.3}'
./tools/cache-warm --targets=eu-west-1a --prefixes=/kv/prefixes/top100
```

deploy-bot: rolling-drain initiated for redwood-pool-gpu7 (batch size=3). job id drain-1749994346

maria (sre): Note cost tradeoff: shifting load cross-AZ will incur egress charges and may push other AZs' GPU pools near capacity. Recommend try eu-west-1a (in-region AZ) before cross-region fallback.

tony (product): We have a reserved dedicated tenant on that pool (tenant: acme-analytics). Any SLA exposure? Please notify account mgmt if we move them.

jamie (infra): We'll pin reserved tenants. Exclude acme-analytics from weight shifts and keep them on isolated nodes; do targeted node-level fixes.

sylvie (eng-sre): Also lowering default model footprint for new allocations to 8-bit quantized variant (model-lite) for the next 30m to reduce memory churn. Pushing canary to 10% now.

arpit (eng-platform): Weight adjust to eu-west-1a returned 200. Cache-warm queued. Drain job drain-1749994346 reports first batch evicted cleanly.

oncall-bot: UPDATE: incident in progress. Actions: weight -0.3 to pool, cordon/drain batches, cache warm, reserved tenant pinned. ETA restore normal: 45-90m. Will update in thread.
